Millions of years ago, the earliest ancestors of a Mediterranean snail, the Cryptomphalus aspersa,emitted a secretion that acted as a defense mechanism to enable their survival as they moved from sea to land. This secretion protected the snail as it encountered new environmental conditions such as extreme temperatures, dryness, humidity and solar radiation for the first time.

The secretion that helped ensure the snails' survival still lives on in the modern day Cryptomphalus aspera snail; in fact, scientists observed that the C. aspersa produces a secretion that protects and repairs its skin from burns and injury in under 48 hours. With further study, it was discovered that SCA (the secretion of C. aspersa) contained many of the same growth factors, amino acids, and antioxidants found in human skin. This finding led scientists to harness the restorative properties of the snail secretion for anti-aging skincare benefits. SCA Biorepair Technology, found exclusively in Tensage Growth Factor, helps reverse the visible signs of aging due to external factors such as sun exposure and environmental damage.

Further research led scientists to discover that the eggs of the C. aspersa yielded unique stem cell activating properties to help combat intrinsic aging of the skin. Tensage Stem Cell, featuring CellPro Technology, helps to activate the skin's own stem cells to produce new healthy cells and restore a healthy, more youthful-looking appearance.

IMPERIAL BARBER PRODUCTS set out to evolve the craft of American mens grooming by bringing time-honored grooming traditions into the home via all-natural, utilitarian, premium products.

Founded in 2009 by Master Barbers Scott Serrata and Pedro Zermeno, Imperial Barber Products set out to evolve the craft of American mens grooming by bringing time-honored grooming traditions into the home via all-natural, utilitarian, premium products. Today, Imperial Barber Products has become an authority in masculine mens grooming.

The team behind Imperial Barber Products have spent a combined 30 years in the Los Angeles, London and New York City barber culture. During that time, they worked to perfect the craft of classic American mens styling. In all those years they never found a hair or grooming product that worked perfectly. Pomades, gels and waxes were too weak, too greasy and waxy, or too fragrant, while shaving products often fell victim to an onslaught of hype that never met expectations.

The Imperial team decided to work together to build the perfect products themselves. The first result was the premium barber-grade, water-based Classic Pomade; customer named, the 'Strongest Water Based Pomade in America'. They spent two-and-a-half years testing the Classic Pomade not only in research labs, but also in barbershops on real customers. The feedback from customers was overwhelmingly positive inspiring them to develop more products.

Purveyors of timeless products rooted in traditional mens grooming, the Imperial team embraces and supports classic American styling. Each product is custom formulated and crafted with performance, utility and function in mind.
All products adhere to the same guidelines:
Made by barbers. Made to work. Made in the USA.

description: A professional-quality heated round brush designed to give you beautiful, "just back from the salon" style. Use it to smooth, direct, lift, volumize, and curl hair like a pro! Maria McCool created the Perfecter with Fusion Heat: ceramic and ionic technology combined to infuse hair with body and shine. Its sturdy bristles glide through hair and protect hands and scalp from heat. Who is it for: All hair types: thin to thick, straight to curly, fine to coarse. Choose the 1" barrel if you have short hair and the 1-1/2" barrel if you have medium to long hair. Why is it different: With a wider heat range and a digital setting for added ease of use, this Perfecter gives you an even better styling experience. Soft Touch grip allows for a more secure hold, while dual inside heaters produce quick, even heat for professional results. How do I use it: Use on dry hair only. Plug in and hold the On/Off button for about three seconds to turn it on. If your hair is fine or over-processed, choose a lower temperature setting; coarse or heavy hair will need a higher setting. The LCD will blink until your desired temperature is reached (takes approximately three minutes). Brush approximately 2" sections from scalp to ends, two to three times, to detangle, remove product, and preheat section for styling. Use slow strokes to help smooth your hair. Add more tension to straighten. When creating waves or curls, do not wind hair more than 2.5 times around the brush. Once you've rolled hair in, hold for 5 to 10 seconds (based on your hair's ability to hold a curl). For long hair, achieve spiral curls by starting at the root, holding the Perfecter vertically, and rotating downward, spinning the hair through the brush for the softest, natural-looking curl. Styling tip: For longer-lasting results, spray each section after styling with Calista Tools Complete Texturizing Spray with ProElement (not included). When you are happy with your overall style, lightly spray hair all ov. Press the power button for 10 seconds to get it to work.

Mustela recognizes that feeling beautiful, healthy, and confident during and after pregnancy is important. Avocado Peptides are the core natural ingredient found in all Mustela Maternity products. Avocado Peptides also promote suppleness, ease tightness and bring elasticity to the skin to prevent and treat the appearance of stretch marks.

Mustela is committed to skin health and uses only safe and effective ingredients in its products. Mustelas formulation guidelines go way beyond current cosmetic standards and will never include any questionable ingredients such as parabens, phthalates, phenoxyethanol, ammonium lauryl sulfate, sodium lauryl sulfate, caffeine, and alcohol. Each and every Mustela formula undergoes a rigorous series of dermatological and gynecological tests to ensure that theyre effective and safe to use. All Mustela Maternity products are clinically proven to be safe for mom and baby during pregnancy and postpartum recovery and are safe to use while breastfeeding.

description: How you dry your hair is one of the most critical steps to caring for your hair. Ideal for fine, curly, or delicate hair, AQUIS Lises Luxe Hair Towels feature a fabric with a completely flat and smooth surface weave. Theyre designed to dry your hair quickly, effectively, and evenly to a damp stage without the damaging effects of heat and bath towels. Textured hair strands come more into contact with this fabric. For every wave or coil, the slightly raised cuticles come into contact with the AQUIS Hair Towel and are dried rapidly and gently, without damaging the fragile cortex of your curly hair. Before use, gently squeeze excess water from hair. Place it at the nape of your neck, making sure the ends of the towel are even. Twist 3 to 4 times, being sure that your hair is tucked into the towel. Flip the towel back towards nape of your neck, and tuck the ends in underneath the towel. Just wrap hair in towel and leave on until hair feels damp to the touch. The average drying time is approximately 6-7 minutes (when you feel your hair is damp to the touch), but it may vary depending on hair type and hair and environmental conditions.

AQUIS products are engineered for both men and women to quickly and efficiently dry your hair. They protect wet hair from the damage caused by heat styling and bath towels so that hair is left looking shinier and healthier.

description: The technology of our Silkn Flash&Go Express is the first of its kind to be approved by the FDA. So skip the expensive office or salon hair removal procedure and try our at home treatment for smooth, soft skin.

Silkn began 10 years ago when esteemed scientists, engineers and professionals set out to develop home use cosmetic devices. Today, 10 million Silkn devices are being used to create smoother, softer, tighter and hair-free skin.

Silkn hair removal devices are based on Home Pulsed Light (HPL) technology which is a proprietary and patented technology that removes unwanted hair. HPL is safe and effective for long-term hair removal because it uses optical light energy.

A quartz bulb delivers the optical light pulse, which is directed into the skin. The light energy is absorbed by the pigment in the hair shaft and is transformed into heat. This heat disables hair growth effectively while leaving the surrounding skin unaffected.

The quartz bulb reloads much faster than previous technologies ever could, which delivers more frequent pulses. Meanwhile, at the same time, the custom designed gliding mechanism allows for smooth movement of the Flash&Go Express on all parts of your body.

description: One of the world's leading lifestyle brands, Calvin Klein is synonymous with authentic modern minimalist style. Everything it creates clothing, accessories, home designbecomes a timeless classic. The label's award-winning fragrances are no exception. Calvin Klein's portfolio of bold and iconic scents continues to redefine the world of perfume. This moisturizing body lotion features the urban woody fresh scent of ck2: a gender free fragrance for men and women, celebrating the diversity of connections between two people. Dual-faceted, ck2s instantly recognizable scent balances two opposing forces  the strike of spicy electric freshness and the warmth of magnetic woods  for a signature that exudes urban, alternative freshness. The strikingly fresh top note, evocative of the electricity of contact, is complemented by solar heat and a feeling of warm stones on a hot day. The drydown of jasmine is enhanced by the scent of vetiver and mixes with the creamy fieriness of sandalwood and sensual musks. Hydrating and refreshing, ck2 body lotion can be used on its own or to complement the Eau de Toilette.

One of the most recognized and influential brands in the world, Calvin Klein is the pre-eminent authority among fashions modernist designers. His name is synonymous with purity, luxury and a refined design aesthetic
Discover CK2
The CK2advertising campaign was shot by acclaimed photographer Ryan McGinley, whose unapologetic, controversial and real vision perfectly complements the spontaneity and thrill of ck2.

The advertising creative features four stories that fold into one another in unexpected ways, creating authentic echoes between glances and the kind of lust or attraction couples can provide. Against the backdrop of urban and natural settings, four couples play out the free spirited, raw and passionate narratives of todays youth. The meaningful connections emphasize the thrill of life shared by two people and magnify the uniqueness of each relationship in our lives shared through a tapestry of experiences and emotion that ultimately define who we are.

CK2 reinterprets minimalism and art by inviting you to look through the clear container and experience the scent before applying. An expression of ck2s gender-free fragrance, the 2-part design unites male and female elements. A sleek rounded bulb of glass houses the juice and sits atop a solid square cap that also serves as a unit to maintain the bottle upside down. Both the bottle and cap go beyond the classic fragrance bottle to create two pieces perfectly in-sync and connected to each other, much like the connection of two people. The bottle is a pure, transparent and futuristic design that is cool and gender-free.
CK2 is a dual-faceted scent that balances two opposing forces: the strike of spicy electric freshness and the warmth of magnetic woods. A signature fragrance for an urban, alternative, new freshness.
Complex while cool and natural, two fragrance worlds merge together to create an exuberant, intimate and contrasted connection.
